hints.content: Let's start by finding the area of each small rectangle separately.

options.alt: An area model for a rectangle that has a height of x plus eight and a width of x plus one. The rectangle is broken into four rectangles to isolate each term in the height and the width. The top left rectangle has a height of x and a width of x. The area of the top left rectangle is x squared. The top right rectangle has a height of x and width of one. The area of the top right rectangle is x. The bottom left rectangle has a height of eight and a width of x. The area of the bottom left rectangle is eight x. The bottom right rectangle has a height of eight and a width of one. The area of the bottom left rectangle is eight.

hints.content:
The area of the entire rectangle is the sum of those areas:

$\begin{align}
\text{Area}&=x^2+x+8x+8
\\\\
&=x^2+9x+8
\end{align}$
